Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Monday Night Malarkey

Matteson, IL · Road

BIPOCBeginner friendly

Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Monday Night Malarkey is a road group ride in Matteson, IL. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Menards parking lot. About 12–25 miles, several groups, 12–17 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @majortaylorchi the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Monday Night Malarkey group ride

Monday evening ride in the south suburbs. Several pace groups from 12 to 17 mph, so newer riders have a place. Hosted by Chicago's Major Taylor club.
